title: Broken Calculator
description: Calculate the minimum operations to reach target from start using doubling or decrementing.
pseudocode:
1. while target > start:
2.   if target is even: target /= 2
3.   else: target += 1
4.   steps++
5. return steps + (start - target)

steps.note: Target (5) is not greater than start (5), exit loop
